A three-member daily rotation with `grid=counted`, `skip_weekends` and `skip_holidays`, anchored Monday 2026-06-01 09:00 and built by weekly runs; the holidays are Wednesday 06-17 and Friday 07-03. Boundaries fall only on counted days, so no shift starts on a weekend or a holiday: Friday shifts run from 09:00 to Monday 09:00, the Tuesday 06-16 shift runs to Thursday 06-18, and the Thursday 07-02 shift runs to Monday 07-06; each of these credits exactly one unit because skipped days credit zero (DESIGN 4). After 25 counted days the snapshot 07-08 09:00 (a Wednesday run inside that day's shift) reads alice=9.00, bob=8.00, carol=8.00, and the round robin alice, bob, carol continues over the next two weeks of counted days up to the horizon boundary 07-22 09:00. The `#All shifts` view in `expected/status.txt` shows the three-day extents of the Friday and pre-holiday shifts.
